paragraphs: StreetSaver is pavement and asset management software, described on its home page as tools to plan, forecast, budget and report. The home page says the software helps cities, counties, and private institutions manage and maintain pavements, roadways, and other infrastructure assets. It is delivered as web based software reachable across a variety of platforms.

Listed capabilities include projecting treatments and costs up to 30 years into the future. The site counts over 90 reports and graphs available to users. Condition data can be collected through a mobile option. The software also extends to non-pavement assets such as traffic signs and curb ramps.

A separate product page sells a PCI distress identification manual covering flexible and rigid pavements. That manual describes each pavement distress type used in StreetSaver and sets criteria for three levels of severity. The home page carries a copyright line naming the Metropolitan Transportation Commission.

quote.text: Our pavement management software delivers informed and timely solutions to implement an effective pavement management program.
